progress_description: Activity practice, not a graded assessment or a statement of mastery.

preparation_module.label: Computer Use and Context Management for Humans

activities.label: Try AI on a useful task
activities.update_note: Current launch edition; existing practice records are retained.
outcomes: A first result and a way to judge it.

atlas.do: Choose something that matters, decide what a useful result would look like and make a first attempt.
atlas.keep: A first result and one clear criterion you can use to judge it.
atlas.knowledge_check: Can I explain why this task matters and what a useful result would look like?
atlas.performance_check: Can I choose a task, give an instruction and compare the result with my criterion?

activities.label: Give AI the right background
activities.update_note: Current launch edition; existing practice records are retained.

atlas.do: Choose helpful details, write a short brief, try it with your AI and work through anything it gets wrong about your intention.
atlas.keep: A brief you can reuse in another conversation.
practise: Selecting relevant information and protecting private details.
Identifying a misunderstanding, clarifying it and checking the revision.
atlas.knowledge_check: Can I explain why a detail helps, what I leave out and how a clarification could address a mismatch?
atlas.performance_check: Can I select useful context, identify a mismatch, clarify it and check the revision?

activities.label: Save your context for next time
activities.update_note: Current launch edition; existing practice records are retained.

atlas.do: Organise useful information about yourself, a project and your sources. Review it, save your documents and reopen them.
atlas.keep: Your own reviewed context portfolio, ready to find and selectively reuse.
practise: Reviewing what to keep and share.
atlas.knowledge_check: Can I explain what belongs in my personal, project and source notes, and how I will find them again?
atlas.performance_check: Can I make a reviewed context document, save it outside this page and reopen the intended copy?

activities.label: Check a result and plan your next step
activities.update_note: Current launch edition; existing practice records are retained.
outcomes: A checked result, an improvement and a next-step plan.

atlas.do: Use an existing brief or an example in a fresh task. Check a result, correct a problem and choose a meaningful next goal.
atlas.keep: A checked result, an improvement worth keeping and a manageable next-step plan.
practise: Checking a result against a criterion.
Reusing context and choosing further practice.
atlas.knowledge_check: Can I explain how I checked the result and distinguish my learning needs from information my AI needs?
atlas.performance_check: Can I test a result, evaluate a correction and design a first step towards my next goal?

activities.label: Files, notes and AI basics — optional help
activities.update_note: Current launch edition; existing practice records are retained.
outcomes: Files and notes you can find again, and an available AI input route.

atlas.do: Practise saving and finding a file, keeping a useful note and using an available way to give your AI an instruction.
atlas.keep: A file and note you can find again, plus a way to give your AI an instruction.
practise: Creating and reopening a useful note.
Transferring information and checking what arrived.
atlas.knowledge_check: Can I explain where my file is stored and how I can return to it?
atlas.performance_check: Can I save, locate and reopen a file, and transfer a useful excerpt into a conversation?
